rules.instrument: Civil Aviation Requirements, Section 3 (Air Transport), Series M, Part IV
instrument_aliases: CAR Section 3 Series M Part IV
rules.text: When a carrier cancels a flight it must inform passengers. Notice of at least two weeks: arrange an alternate flight or refund as acceptable to the passenger. Notice of less than two weeks but at least 24 hours: offer an alternate flight departing within two hours of the original departure, or a refund as acceptable to the passenger.

rules.instrument: Civil Aviation Requirements, Section 3 (Air Transport), Series M, Part IV
instrument_aliases: CAR Section 3 Series M Part IV
rules.provision: Cancellations: refund of the ticket when no alternate flight is accepted
rules.text: A passenger whose flight is cancelled by the carrier and who does not accept an alternate flight is entitled to a refund of the ticket.

rules.instrument: Civil Aviation Requirements, Section 3 (Air Transport), Series M, Part IV
instrument_aliases: CAR Section 3 Series M Part IV
rules.provision: Cancellations: compensation in addition to refund
rules.text: If the carrier did not give the required notice or alternative, it pays compensation in addition to the refund: the lesser of a block-time based amount (INR 5,000 up to one hour; INR 7,500 above one and up to two hours; INR 10,000 above two hours) and the booked one-way basic fare plus airline fuel charge.

rules.instrument: Civil Aviation Requirements, Section 3 (Air Transport), Series M, Part IV
instrument_aliases: CAR Section 3 Series M Part IV
rules.text: Compensation is not payable when the cancellation is caused by extraordinary circumstances beyond the carrier's control (for example weather, natural disaster, security or air-traffic restrictions). The refund entitlement is unaffected.

rules.instrument: Civil Aviation Requirements, Section 3 (Air Transport), Series M, Part II
instrument_aliases: CAR Section 3 Series M Part II
rules.provision: Refund timelines by mode of payment
rules.text: Refunds are to be completed within 7 days for credit-card purchases, immediately for cash purchases at the airline office, and within 30 days for purchases through a travel agent or portal.

rules.instrument: Civil Aviation Requirements, Section 3 (Air Transport), Series M, Part II
instrument_aliases: CAR Section 3 Series M Part II
rules.provision: Credit shell only at the passenger's option
rules.text: Holding a refund as a credit shell is the passenger's option, not the carrier's default practice; a credit shell issued without the passenger's consent is not a refund.

rules.instrument: RBI circular on harmonisation of turn-around time and customer compensation for failed transactions (20 September 2019)
rules.provision: UPI: account debited but beneficiary not credited
rules.text: For a UPI transfer where the customer's account is debited but the beneficiary is not credited, the amount is to be reversed by T+1; beyond that the bank pays compensation of INR 100 per day of delay.
